og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 42% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 159 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 26, 7:35 AM ET.
